title: The confirm transaction: what is inside it, in what order, and what a unique violation means
notes: READ COMMITTED; the unique constraint is the guard. A unique violation is the guard working, translated to 409, never retried and never a 500.

title: The seat-map cache: cache-aside, deleted after commit, and stampede-guarded
notes: DEL not SET after commit, plus a per-key rebuild lock. Worst-case staleness about 13 seconds, at the edge of SRC-001 3.3.

title: The receipt job is enqueued through a transactional outbox, not a post-commit send
